findings.finding: The manual K-menu shows Freeze VL matrices(fast):T. This supports declaring frozen influences for a conditional numerical pilot, but no archived script explicitly selects K/F and no retained .set authenticates the actual producing setting.

Primary NACA TN2563 Figure18 visibly places the first locked20% circular observation at nominal q10 psf, while retained CSV records11.355860433604331 psf. Other primary symbols share the nominal10 psf first grid line. No recalibration or raw-point replacement is made here; a literal digitized-pressure numerical pilot is not an exact primary-condition comparison.

All six files use m,s,N; g9.81,rhoSL1.2256,aSL340.21. Ground 1 t0 with omitted KGtype is rigid structural mount0. This does not itself specify the global operating constraint table or aerodynamic ground image.

The chord distribution begins at t0; documented surface symmetry generates full material domain [-.6096,.6096], with y reflected. All other geometry/stiffness/mass distributions beginning at0 are copied; aileron laws explicitly cover both signs. Beam1 !V has physical index1; !V is an inline comment, not an executable flag.

Zero twist/dihedral, one straight tapered full wing, root/tip chord .2093/.0942m, span1.2192m. Literal leading/reference x -.0523/-.0236m and Xax=0; the .38 multiplier multiplies zero Xax. Cea=Cta=.38 chord. Material leading-edge sweep is nonzero; nominal unswept quarter-chord x is +.000025/-.00005m from rounded entries, not exactly zero. Planform area .1850136m² differs reference .185m² by literal rounding; mean reference chord is .15m.

All six have identical literal GJ/EIcc data: t multiplier .6096, GJ2.5, EIcc3.8. Effective root20/34.2 and tip.63125/1.18104 N m². EIcc is bending about local c/out-of-plane; GJ torsion about s. Omitted EInn, EA, GKc/GKn are rigid by documented defaults; omitted couplings0. Distributed and added weights/inertias0. Both point weights have Mg multiplier0; torque and lb-force comments introduce no load. No mass/inertia distribution for dynamics is recovered.

All files retain dCLda5.66/rad, alpha0, twist0, Cm0, CLmin/max±1.2, zero profile coefficients. Positive-side aileron dCL is positive and dCM negative; opposite on negative side. Straight20=.0581/−.0102, Straight40=.0686/−.0107, other60/80/95=.0686/−.0102; Roll=0/0. Thus the named span variants are not a span-only sweep. Generic flap units are arbitrary; archive XFOIL/Post labels use degrees. ASWING alpha means zero-lift-line inclination above c, not conventional alpha0 sign.

Roll_rate requests six indicated speeds and !!F1=1 for all existing points. temp requests nine speeds then !F1=1 only for current last point; preceding values are inherited unknowns. Roll_analysis fixes indicated50.9314 and requests seven Wx values in deg/s. No script gives explicit incidence, NODE/modes, K/F, density/altitude or image setting. Startup can load basename .set/.pnt/.con, none retained here.

Within %, 4 23 toggles a numeric cell; P applies all points and d exits. Its exact equations are not recovered. Extended Manual Fig1.5 p12 instead labels col4 angular acceleration and row23 engine setting; Wx/Mx are col10/row27 in that generic example. This is evidence against blindly decoding the archived cell with that figure, not evidence the original script was invalid.

The six fmat files are human-labelled mass/force/derivative reports. All have title Mowe_temp, Mach0, alpha/beta/Wx/Wy/Wz0 and nonzero Cl; their q/V are consistent with rho1.2256. They are not free-roll solutions and do not authenticate the current Straight20 model, despite matching Roll_rate speeds.

Post_analysis uses rho1.292 to convert hard-coded ASW speed arrays to q, versus model rhoSL1.2256. Lowest locked20 speed29.0109 is generated by raw CSV q using1.292, not by literal sea-level density. The saved fmat q-values demonstrate the distinction. Do not equate script indicated speed, actual TAS, MATLAB plotted q and measured q without their density/state context.

Post_analysis contains hard-coded ASW and ASW-mod arrays rather than loading fmat. clear all is followed by first use of undefined b in helix expression at207; its p arrays have unstated units and are marked modified. The later 95% experimental fit uses q80O at275. Thus retained plotting source is not a self-contained producer of all reported curves. Preserve original points, no repaired fit or inferred p unit here.

ISAE report numerical bench names alpha0=0, clalpha5.66, dcl/dF.0581 and dcm/dF−.0107, not the retained Straight20 pair. It distinguishes constant highest-Re ASWING5.96 from an ASWING-m local-Re lookup modification; no such lookup law is in the six literal files. Report explicitly says physical mass/inertia distributions were unavailable. Literal files must not be silently altered to match report or experiment.
